OpenSCAD.OpenSCAD: OpenSCAD is software for creating solid 3D CAD objects.

OpenSCAD is software for creating solid 3D CAD models. It is free software and available for Linux/UNIX, Windows and Mac OS X. Unlike most free software for creating 3D models (such as Blender) it does not focus on the artistic aspects of 3D modelling but instead on the CAD aspects. Thus it might be the application you are looking for when you are planning to create 3D models of machine parts but pretty sure is not what you are looking for when you are more interested in creating computer-animated movies.

OpenSCAD is not an interactive modeller. Instead it is something like a 3D-compiler that reads in a script file that describes the object and renders the 3D model from this script file. This gives you (the designer) full control over the modelling process and enables you to easily change any step in the modelling process or make designs that are defined by configurable parameters.

OpenSCAD provides two main modelling techniques: First there is constructive solid geometry (aka CSG) and second there is extrusion of 2D outlines. Autocad DXF files can be used as the data exchange format for such 2D outlines. In addition to 2D paths for extrusion it is also possible to read design parameters from DXF files. Besides DXF files OpenSCAD can read and create 3D models in the STL and OFF file formats.

Oxolan is a LAN file-sharing app for Windows and macOS offices. It automatically discovers every machine on your local network and transfers files directly between them at full LAN speed over its own encrypted protocol, so files never pass through the cloud.

It is built as a practical replacement for SMB / Windows File Sharing, mapped network drives, and cloud sync tools for teams that all work in one building. Typical users are architecture and engineering studios, photo and video editors, animation studios, clinics, and accounting or legal firms that move large files between computers on the same network.

Features include automatic device discovery, drag-and-drop transfer, shared workspace folder sync with conflict handling, file locking, remote browse and search of a connected machine's files, and RAW photo preview without downloading. Transfers are encrypted with TLS 1.3 using certificate pinning and per-chunk BLAKE3 integrity checks, and large transfers are resumable after a crash or reboot.

Oxolan does not depend on SMB or Windows network discovery, so it is unaffected by the network-discovery and credential-prompt problems those systems are prone to. It is a local-network tool and is not intended for syncing across the internet.
